newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on CBOT soycomplex, hedges.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on CBOT soycomplex, hedges.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended lower, pulled down by lower CBOT soy complex futures and hedges, traders said.
"We're down on Chicago. There were moderate hedges, there was some bear spreading with buying of the Nov and selling of the May," a trader said.
May WCE futures crush profit margin rose to -11.18 Tuesday from -11.92 Wednesday. May-Nov spread at $59, Sep-Nov $7. Volume was 4,600 lots, or 92,000 tonnes, with 606 hedges.
Japan bought 1,000-2,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
May lost $3.60 to $427.70 and July fell $2.20 to $431. May flax rose $2 to $357 as UGG bought July lost $0.50 to $354.50, traders said.
May western barley lost $1.60 to $139.70 and July fell $1.70 to $138.80 on commercial and commission selling. May-July spread at $1. Volume was 1,000 lots.
May feed wheat lost $0.80 to $167.20, July fell $0.80 to $164.70 on commercial trade. May-July spread at $2.50. Volume was 565 lots.
UGG sold 40 May pea contracts up US$1.50 at US$217.50, traders said.
Commission houses sold five July up US$1.50 to US$193 and PCTS sold 10 October up US$1.50 to US$192 and sold 50 December up US$1.40 at US$192.50 to UGG, traders said.
XCan sold five May oat contracts down US$2.70 to US$127 to RBC-DS, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars, except feed peas)
